attributes.summary: One-shot authorization bridge for a compiler-mined OpenHours hook.
Canonical five-permission Uniswap v4 OpenHours hook.
Atomic token, vault, pool initialization, funding, approval, and locked-liquidity launcher.

atomicExecution.failurePolicy: Any failed dependency check, deployment, initializer, registration, pool initialization, transfer, approval, position mint, custody check, or post-state assertion reverts the outer launch transaction.
preconditions: The launch-session wallet owns at least 100000000000 USDC base units.
The launch-session wallet has approved exactly 100000000000 USDC base units to the compiler-predicted target:launcher address.
All seven declared dependency runtimes match dependencyBindings immediately before execution.

rollback.externalApproval: A failed launch does not consume the pre-existing exact USDC allowance; the wallet can retry the same deterministic launch or revoke that allowance.
rollback.scope: factory initialization, hook and launcher deployments, launcher-created token and vault, registration, initialization, transfers, Permit2 approvals, and PositionManager mint all share one outer transaction and revert together

steps.calldata: 0x28a76f49 plus target:launcher as one ABI address word

effects: deploy child:token with 1000000000 OPEN fixed supply to target:launcher
deploy child:vault bound to child:token, USDC, target:hook, and launch-session wallet
register the complete PoolKey and initialize PoolManager
pull exactly 100000 USDC from the launch-session wallet
approve token and USDC to Permit2 and Permit2 to PositionManager for exact computed amounts
mint the full-range PositionManager NFT directly to the permanent custody address
clear ERC20 and Permit2 approval amounts
refund unused token and USDC budgets to the launch-session wallet

custody.policy: The PositionManager NFT is minted directly to this non-recoverable address; no remove-liquidity authority exists.

directlyTradableEndState.failureHandling: All launch-time state changes revert atomically. Post-launch swaps use caller-supplied amount bounds and deadlines and revert on expiration, insufficient output, excessive input, missing allowance, transfer failure, hook failure, or router/runtime mismatch.

liquidity.amountPolicy: Compute the maximum full-range liquidity supported by both fixed budgets at the initialized sqrt price; round token debts upward; refund both unused remainders.

approvals.buyUSDCInput: USDC approve Permit2, then Permit2 approve identity:universal-router for the bounded amount and expiration
approvals.sellOPENInput: OPEN approve Permit2, then Permit2 approve identity:universal-router for the bounded amount and expiration

internalChildPlans.constructor: new EpochRedemptionVault(child:token, identity:quote-usdc, target:hook, input:launch-session-wallet, input:launch-session-wallet)

navProductionBoundary.authenticatedProducer: The issuer-operated NAV producer defined in docs/NAV_PRODUCER_BOUNDARY.md signs EIP-712 epoch data through an HSM or KMS-held key whose Ethereum address equals the immutable vault navSigner.
navProductionBoundary.clientBoundary: The producer submits only openEpoch calls to child:vault through the production RPC relay; browsers and the launch adapter never receive signing material.
navProductionBoundary.failurePolicy: No NAV or stale source data means no new epoch. Existing signed epochs cannot be refreshed or extended, and expiry causes redemption to fail closed. Pool trading remains independent.
navProductionBoundary.freshness: The producer rejects observations older than 300 seconds and signs deadlines no more than 900 seconds after observation.
navProductionBoundary.launchState: No redemption epoch is open at launch; NAV production is not a prerequisite for the directly tradable pool.

postStateAssertions: Every constructor dependency has nonempty code and its exact bound runtime hash.
PositionManager.poolManager equals identity:pool-manager and PositionManager.permit2 equals identity:permit2.
target:hook has exact permission bits 0x30c0 and immutable PoolManager, registrar, and quote bindings.
target:factory authorization is consumed and target:hook canonical registration is one-shot.
PoolManager slot0 is initialized at the exact orientation-dependent initial tick and dynamic stored LP fee.
child:vault is bound to the canonical PoolId and child:token.
child:token total supply equals 1000000000000000000000000000 with no mint authority.
PositionManager owns no residual OPEN or USDC after settlement.
The minted PositionManager NFT owner equals 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead and liquidity is nonzero.
target:launcher ERC20 allowances to Permit2 are zero and Permit2 allowance amounts to PositionManager are zero.
target:launcher retains zero OPEN and zero USDC; every unused budget unit is returned to the launch-session wallet.
